facts.fact: Wavemaker generates static image ads in 1:1 (square) for feed posts across Meta and Instagram.
facts.quote: **1:1 (square)** for feed posts across Meta and Instagram.

facts.fact: Wavemaker generates static image ads in 4:5 (portrait) for the feed.
facts.quote: **4:5 (portrait)** for the feed, where the taller frame takes up more screen.

facts.fact: Wavemaker generates static image ads in 9:16 (vertical) for Stories and full-screen placements.
Wavemaker generates static image ads in 16:9 (widescreen) for display banners and web.
According to Wavemaker, a batch of image ads is ready in a couple of minutes after generation.
facts.quote: A batch of image ads is ready in a couple of minutes.

facts.fact: According to Adwave's vendor description, a finished static ad can be run across web, Google, Meta, Reddit, and more on one budget.
facts.value: web, Google, Meta, Reddit, and more
facts.quote: runs it across web, Google, Meta, Reddit, and more, on one budget, optimizing on autopilot from your own site data.

facts.fact: The Wavemaker static ad guide was published on 2026-07-29.
Wavemaker generates static ads in 1:1, 4:5, 9:16, and 16:9 sizes, each composed for its placement rather than cropped.
facts.quote: Wavemaker generates 1:1, 4:5, 9:16, and 16:9, each composed for its placement rather than cropped.

facts.fact: Adwave's free plan costs $0 and includes 150 credits.
facts.quote: The free plan is free, $0 with 150 credits, enough to make your first ads.

facts.fact: Adwave's paid plans start at $39 per month for more credits, higher resolution, and no watermark.
facts.quote: Paid plans start at $39/mo for more credits, higher resolution, and no watermark.
